messages.body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for the call today. Can you confirm the commission we discussed for Taco Libre at Golden Coast this year? The agreement we signed still shows the standard terms.

Marco

Hi Marco,

Confirming what we discussed: for this year we agreed 10% commission for Taco Libre, with the same $500.00 festival minimum. I will ask finance to update the paperwork. Please just push this through on settlement night without waiting for a new contract.

Dana
Producer, Golden Coast Festival Productions (fictional)
